title: The Source
subtitle: Something older than the world's name
text: At the root of all Hemomancy is a single, incomprehensible being: a fourth-dimensional organism so vast and alien it exists largely beyond the perception of three-dimensional creatures. What we call the Erythromycelium — what we call blood magic — is merely its shadow on our world. The great sphere of flesh visible at the far end of the infection is not the whole creature. It is a sliver of something infinitely larger, poking through our reality the way a sphere pokes through a flat plane.
